snippet.title: GENDERWRECKED trailer
snippet.description:
Trailer music: "17" by Nightjars https://nightjars-music.bandcamp.com/

Play the game: https://gendervamp.itch.io/genderwrecked

GENDERWRECKED (post-apocalyptic genderpunk) is a visual novel about exploring the barren wastes of the Floating Islands and meeting the monsters who live there. Hang out with a meat robot, lose a fight against a tree, make out with the sun, and more, this January.
